status.d: Minor Industrial is permitted in BE; Major Industrial is not. A large data centre is treated by the City as Major Industrial. A smaller one whose noise, emissions and fuel or battery hazards stay inside the site could be argued as Minor Industrial — the Development Planner decides.

loadingNeed.basis: 1 loading space for 7,301 m² of floor area (Table 7.2). Each 9.0 × 3.0–3.3 m, 4.0 m clear, wholly on site, with no backing onto streets or alleys (s. 5.80 subs. 7). Aisle: Vancouver's 6.1 m used as an assumption.

s.src: Air-cooled chillers with free-cooling coils (air cooling): an air-cooled hall needs chilled water at about 13 °C or warmer (NREL for DOE FEMP, Best Practices Guide 2024, s. 5.2.1), and a dry cooler cannot cool water below the outdoor air (rated units leave it 3–11 K above), so chillers carry the full load in summer; free-cooling coils on the chillers take no extra footprint (Trane white paper DC-WPR006A, manufacturer claim). 7 air-cooled chillers carry it; with spares, 8. Placed: 8 on the roof, 0 in the yard.
